name: Spann3R
definition: A feature fusion mechanism that predicts pointmaps in a global coordinate frame to avoid the time-consuming and memory-intensive post-processing alignment step used by DUSt3R when handling more than two images.
summary: Spann3R is a feature fusion mechanism that predicts dense global pointmaps directly, eliminating the pairwise alignment overhead required by DUSt3R for multi-view reconstruction.
